from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class EarningsMetric(BaseModel):
    """A single earnings per share data point extracted from one financial filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The registrant company name found in the filing")
    basic_eps_value: float | None = Field(description="The basic earnings per share value; negative values indicate loss")
    metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line item label describing the EPS metric")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period end date (e.g., 'March 31, 2024')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    earnings_metrics: list[EarningsMetric]
